entries.title: II Corinthians 9:1
segments: For indeed regarding the ministry to the saints, it is not necessary for me to write to you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:2
segments: For I know your eagerness, of which I boast to Macedonia on your behalf, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal has aroused the greater number.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:3
segments: Yet I sent the brothers, lest our boasting (which [is] on your behalf) should not be in vain, that, as I said, you may be ready.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:4
segments: [I say this] lest perhaps Macedonians should come with me and find you unprepared. We (not to say you) would then be put to shame in this confident boasting.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:5
segments: Therefore I thought [it] necessary to exhort the brothers that they would go forward to you, and make up beforehand your blessing, it having been promised that this would be ready, thus as [a matter of] blessing, and not as of covetousness.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:6
segments: But [I say] this, He who sows sparingly shall also reap sparingly, and he who sows bountifully shall also reap bountifully.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:7
segments: Each one, as he purposes in his heart, [let him give]; not of grief, or of necessity, for God loves a cheerful giver.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:8
segments: And God [is] able to make all grace abound toward you, that in everything, always having all self-sufficiency, you may abound to every good work;

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:9
segments: As it is written, "He scattered; he has given to the poor; his righteousness remains forever."

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:10
segments: Now He who supplies seed to the sower, and bread for eating, may He supply and multiply your seed, and increase the fruits of your righteousness

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:11
segments: you being enriched in everything to all generosity, which works out thanksgiving to God through us.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:12
segments: For the ministry of this service not only supplies the things lacking of the saints, but also multiplying through many thanksgivings to God,

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:13
segments: through the proof of this ministry [they] glorify God for your freely expressed submission to the gospel of Christ, and the generosity of the fellowship toward them and toward all,

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:14
segments: and [in] their prayer for you, who long after you, because of the exceeding grace of God on you.

entries.title: II Corinthians 9:15
segments: Thanks [be] to God for His unspeakable free gift.
